name: enable_material
description: Controls whether the query planner considers materialization (caching intermediate results) as an execution strategy.
symptoms: Suboptimal query plans for nested loops or repeated subqueries
Higher CPU usage due to redundant computation
Slower execution of queries with expensive, reusable subplans
tuning_tips: Disable only for debugging or to force alternative plans; avoid in production unless validated by EXPLAIN ANALYZE showing materialization harms performance.
